verdict.rationale: The docs show programmatic session management: you can launch a cloud browser, connect over CDP, and stop it. A session ID can hold multiple runs and reuse a live browser, and runs are created via a client API. However, nothing in the evidence documents running many sessions in parallel or any concurrency limits; the GitHub 'at scale' line is only a marketing hint. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas, explicit evidence of concurrent multi-session fleets, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel scale.
